newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Malaysia's Sime Bank unit sets $100 mln FRCD.

SHAREHOLDERS' COVENANT: HOLDERS OF THE FRCDS WILL HAVE THE RIGHT TO REQUIRE THE ISSUER TO REDEEM THE FRCDS AT PAR PLUS ACCRUED INTEREST AT ANY TIME UPON THE OCCURRENCE OF ANY ONE OF THE EVENTS - SIME DARBY BHD CEASES TO BE, DIRECTLY OR INDIRECTLY, THE LARGEST SHAREHOLDER OF THE GUARANTOR, OR SIME DARBY BHD CEASES TO CONTROL THE MANAGEMENT OF THE GUARANTOR.
SIGNING IS SET FOR MARCH 5.
CLEARING THROUGH EUROCLEAR/CEDEL.
